verdict.rationale: 1Password ships CLI/SDK/API docs, llms.txt exports, and an MCP server, but nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API reference with runnable/try-it examples (e.g., an API console or embedded sandbox); the CLI reference is static text, not executable in-browser. missing for 10: an interactive API explorer/playground, evidence of runnable code samples, any 'try it' console for the REST or SDK APIs.
